measurement.state: Not separately restated; follows unpowered B61
measurement.raw_user_statement: TP14 and pin 8 of the MX512H are connected - 1.5ohm

assessment: B60 6.3 V rejects BATTERY+ membership. B61 516 ohm does not support a direct gate-node join. The user then measured TP14 to MX512H pin8 at 1.5 ohm, supporting OUTA/H_MOTOR_A. Prior TP14-R43.2 continuity is retained.
limit: The measured net membership is supported; motor direction, bridge state, R43 function and the path producing 516 ohm to Q1.R are not established.
